title: Get TPU Cube Partition State
description: Read-only per-node cube view for TPU7x (Ironwood) on GKE on AI Hypercomputer. Lists every node of the current cluster context with three label columns: `cloud.google.com/gke-nodepool` (one TPU node pool = one 4x4x4 cube = one reservation sub-block of 16 VMs), `cloud.google.com/gke-tpu-partition-4x4x4-state` (the cube's partition state) and `cloud.google.com/report-and-replace-status` (progress of a report-and-replace request), next to the default STATUS column (Ready / NotReady; cordoned nodes show SchedulingDisabled). Group the rows by node pool: a cube is healthy when all 16 nodes are registered, Ready and schedulable and the partition state is HEALTHY or DEGRADED (DEGRADED = running on ICI resiliency after a single OCS failure; still usable). Cluster-wide, not workload-scoped. Taints are not shown; use [[get-nodes-taints]] for those.
